description: Bounded public disposition for expert-major grouping of routed experts on the Alice MoE layer: 0.185 to 6.115 TMAC/s at B=4096 (33.0x, lower bound ~43x after copy correction), a route-materialisation helper rewrite removing 19.3%/29.5% of the grouped step at B=4096/5796, bit-exact 32/32 same-kernel parity, the MMVQ-versus-MMQ kernel-selection explanation for an earlier apparent 1.14e-2 delta, and the CPU-MoE prefill regression that is retired. The executing runtime tree, model weights, container bytes, and raw receipts are excluded from publication; values below are sanitized summaries of campaign-local receipts.
model_name: Alice MoE layer geometry (512 experts, top-10, expert_ff 512) on real expert slabs
model_revision: campaign-local expert slabs derived from the Alice source checkpoint; excluded from publication
model_download_source: public base checkpoint exists; no weight payload is part of this repository
quant_name: Q3_K gate/up and Q4_K down expert slabs as deployed

gpu_configuration: RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; ROCm/HIP mul_mat_id path

expected_range.apparent_delta_cause: runtime kernel selection: MMVQ at 1 row, MMQ at B >= 32

tolerance.tmac_per_s: single-layer kernel measurement, not a model-level rate

known_limitations: A local kernel win is not a full-model multiplier; the deployed-configuration gate returned REVERT.
The Amdahl ceiling for this lever is ~1.65x because the grouped expert GEMM is ~44.6% of the step.
The CPU-MoE prefill path is a -85.1% regression and is retired.
Expert slabs and the instrumenting runtime are excluded, so this lane is a disposition.
